title: Shadow Beat Switch 150 (instrumental, 1:30)
style: Instrumental, no vocals, 150 BPM with a half-time 75 BPM feel, A minor, 4/4, dark Korean hip-hop / hard trap beat, the heavy second half after a beat switch: opens with a short ominous atmospheric build with eerie pads and a distant siren-like synth, then a sudden beat switch into a heavy aggressive trap beat with deep distorted 808 bass, hard punchy kicks and cracking snares, rapid hi-hat rolls, menacing string stabs and a dark brooding synth motif, sinister, intense, cinematic
lyrics:
[Intro - instrumental, ominous atmospheric build, eerie pads, no drums]

[Beat switch - instrumental, sudden heavy drop, deep distorted 808 bass, hard kicks and cracking snares, hi-hat rolls]

[Breakdown - instrumental, dark synth motif over held 808, sparse drums]

[Drop - instrumental, heavy aggressive trap beat, menacing string stabs, full energy]

[Outro - instrumental, beat cuts out, eerie pad fades]
